name: B10-0460/2026 (ECR) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Azerbaijan to free three jailed men: opposition leader Ali Karimli, election monitor Anar Mammadli and activist Anar Abdullayev. It says their trials were politically motivated and unfair. It also urges Azerbaijan to stop prosecuting critics, treat prisoners decently and let them see lawyers and family. The Parliament asks the European Union's office in Baku to watch these cases and wants the European Union to do more to support human rights and democracy in Azerbaijan. The text is a request, not a law, so nothing changes automatically.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks Azerbaijan to act.
- **Who it affects:** Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli, Anar Abdullayev and other prisoners in Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** The request goes to Azerbaijan's government and parliament; the European Union's Baku office is asked to monitor.
